- On 10 Nov 2026, Burnpur Cement Ltd received a notice that UV Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd has reassigned the company’s debt (including all underlying securities and rights) to CFM Asset Reconstruction Private Ltd, and the firm will update its records accordingly.  
- The announcement contains no specific monetary amounts, interest rates, or other financial figures related to the debt reassignment.
